record.title: CFTC advance notice on leveraged retail crypto (Regulation CTX and CAM)
record.sub: Commodity Futures Trading Commission · latest step: October 5, 2026
record.text: Consider a federal venue, a new kind of regulated exchange, for retail crypto trades that use leverage, margin or financing. Ordinary unleveraged spot trading would stay outside it.
kv: An advance notice of proposed rulemaking announced October 5, 2026. It asks whether and how to write rules; there is no rule text yet. Comments are due 60 days after Federal Register publication.

events.what: CFTC sends the pre-rule action (RIN 3038-AF80) to the White House for review

open: The notice's text and Federal Register date were not public at the library's cutoff.
